title.narrative: UNICEF supported Ministry of Youth and Sports and MoE to enhance stakeholder capacity, expand alternative learning opportunities for 21,623 out-of-school learners and at-risk adolescents, build transferable skills in foundational literacy and numeracy, mental health, climate action and leadership. The Adolescent Advisory Group strengthened adolescent involvement in leadership at all levels.
